title: Catch Weight Trend by Tackle
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch
| stats avg(weight_kg) as avg_weight, max(weight_kg) as best_weight, count as catches by tackle
| sort - avg_weight
description: Shows which tackle setups are producing heavier catches over time.
value: This keeps tackle decisions grounded in results instead of stories about what should have worked.
implementation: Log tackle used and catch weight in `index=personal`; compare average and best catch weight by setup.
visualization: Tackle table of average weight, best weight, and catch count.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which tackle setups really produce the heavier catches instead of only feeling lucky on a good day.
